title: Signs, pillars and the dark below
short: Clear signs everywhere: red stop, yellow warning, green done.
Slim pillars between rooms that match the wall behind them.
Three new back walls, and the untouched mountain is now dark.

details.head: Signs and buttons
items: Rooms, hints, tabs and messages use three drawn signs: a red octagon (stopped), a yellow triangle (needs you) and a green circle (done, collect the loot).
Trade depot and adventurers' guild show the green sign when a report waits; the forge shows it when hot metal is ready to quench.
All buttons are forged metal plates that press in; windows have a new close button.
Every sign is drawn as one half and mirrored, so they are all symmetrical.

details.head: The hold
items: Pillars between rooms are half as wide, take the stone or wood of the room's back wall and carry a band, runes or a banner.
Doors sit inside the pillars and only show while they swing open.
New back walls for your room looks: half-timbering, slate and glazed tiles.
Rock nobody uses is dark. About one floor around every dug space stays visible and fades out. In build mode the dark is see-through.
No more light seams in the rock when you zoom.

details.head: Fixes
items: Clicking in the valley no longer opens the mines.
Chronicle lines no longer get squashed.
